decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine builds on the firm's core automation offer and was launched only in 2024, so its results cannot yet be judged against the firm's aspiration; the firm's recent pattern of removing its robot products from the website does add some risk of further pruning.

Production analysis software is cheap to keep on offer, fits the firm's controls and lifecycle-support strategy, and strengthens its integrated plant solutions, so with industry turnover growing there is little shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
